name: Forged Steel
label: Quest
description: Thun'grim Firegaze waits in the eastern Barrens for the steel stolen from his camp. He offers to forge a weapon for the warrior who brings it back.

clips.title: The story
paras: Thun'grim Firegaze waits in the eastern Barrens for the steel stolen from his camp. He offers to forge a weapon for the warrior who brings it back.

Thun'grim Firegaze keeps a smithy in the eastern Barrens, far from Orgrimmar. Years at the forge have dimmed his sight. The nearby Razormane quilboar used that weakness to steal an iron chest from his camp. Some snorted and made noise on one side to draw his gaze while others slipped in from the other and carried off his forged steel bars.

Thun'grim is angry at the theft, but doubts the Razormanes can use the steel. Quilboar craft with stone, tusks, and thorny roots, not refined metal. The heavy chest remains near a broken wagon in their camp, untouched and useless to them. For Thun'grim, its steel is the stock he needs to forge weapons for young Horde warriors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I will give you a weapon, friend, but first you must aid me. The Razormanes to the northwest came into my camp a few nights past. They would not meet me in combat, but they know my eyes are bad--a few distracted me with snorts while others stole from me! The cowards!
They took an iron chest, and within it were some forged steel bars. If you can recover them then I will give you the weapon you seek.
Search for the iron box within the quilboar camps, and return with the forged steel bars.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have my steel bars?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found them! And all the bars are here, which doesn't surprise me. I didn't think the Razormanes would know what to do with fine steel like this.
Thank you, friend. Here is your reward. May it serve you well.
